item.text: The Corruption and Crime Commission and Murdoch University jointly investigated complaints concerning the then vice-chancellor's conduct.
item.support: The Commission undertook a co-operative investigation with Murdoch.

item.text: The report examined senior appointments, an appointment's termination and breaches of policies on adult material.
item.section: Matters that fall within the scope of this report
item.support: the breach of policy by downloading adult material and subsequent attempts to delete it.

item.text: The Commission formed a serious misconduct opinion about one senior appointment and misconduct opinions about misleading statements and the adult material policy breaches.
item.section: Matters that fall within the scope of this report
item.support: In one area the Commission has formed an opinion of serious misconduct

item.text: It considered further recommendations unnecessary on credit card use and document retention because the university had accepted consultants' recommendations and improved its practices.
item.support: improved its practices surrounding credit card use and document retention, the Commission has no need to make any recommendations.
